metadata.question: Did the rate of cropland expansion slow in Africa from 2016-2019 compared to 2004-2007?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about cropland expansion rates in Africa between two time periods: 2004-2007 vs 2016-2019. This requires: 1. Strategy: Use land cover classification data to detect cropland areas 2. Data: MODIS Land Cover (MCD12Q1) would be good for this timeframe 3. Processing: Calculate cropland area for each period and compute expansion rates 4. Logic: Compare the annual expansion rates between periods I need to: - Define Africa boundary - Get land cover data for both periods - Extract cropland areas (class 12 in IGBP classification) - Calculate expansion rates - Compare rates and determine if it slowed Potential issues: - No data in collection (C1) - No valid pixels after masking (C2) - Invalid calculations (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Africa boundary var africa = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('wld_rgn', 'Africa')); // Get MODIS Land Cover data var modis2004_2007 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD12Q1') .filterDate('2004-01-01', '2007-12-31') .filterBounds(africa); var modis2016_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD12Q1') .filterDate('2016-01-01', '2019-12-31') .filterBounds(africa); // Check collection sizes var size1 = modis2004_2007.size().getInfo(); var size2 = modis2016_2019.size().getInfo(); print(`2004-2007 Images: ${size1}`); print(`2016-2019 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { print("C1"); return; } // Get first and last images for each period var first2004 = modis2004_2007.filterDate('2004-01-01', '2004-12-31').first(); var last2007 = modis2004_2007.filterDate('2007-01-01', '2007-12-31').first(); var first2016 = modis2016_2019.filterDate('2016-01-01', '2016-12-31').first(); var last2019 = modis2016_2019.filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31').first(); // Define cropland class (12 = croplands in IGBP classification) var croplandClass = 12; // Calculate cropland areas in km² var area2004 = first2004.eq(croplandClass).multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1000000)) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: africa, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); var area2007 = last2007.eq(croplandClass).multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1000000)) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: africa, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); var area2016 = first2016.eq(croplandClass).multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1000000)) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: africa, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); var area2019 = last2019.eq(croplandClass).multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1000000)) .reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: africa, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels if (area2004 === null || area2007 === null || area2016 === null || area2019 === null) { print("C2"); return; } // Calculate annual expansion rates var rate2004_2007 = (area2007 - area2004) / 3; // 3 years between start and end var rate2016_2019 = (area2019 - area2016) / 3; print(`2004 Cropland: ${area2004.toFixed(0)} km²`); print(`2007 Cropland: ${area2007.toFixed(0)} km²`); print(`2016 Cropland: ${area2016.toFixed(0)} km²`); print(`2019 Cropland: ${area2019.toFixed(0)} km²`); print(`2004-2007 Rate: ${rate2004_2007.toFixed(0)} km²/yr`); print(`2016-2019 Rate: ${rate2016_2019.toFixed(0)} km²/yr`); // Check for calculation failures if (!isFinite(rate2004_2007) || !isFinite(rate2016_2019)) { print("C3"); return; } // Determine if expansion slowed if (rate2016_2019 < rate2004_2007) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
